# JobFace

JobFace is a web tool for job seekers. It provides a free resume photo maker, professional headshot guidance, a basic resume builder, and resume template starting points.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://jobface.wezzik.com/
- Free resume photo maker: https://jobface.wezzik.com/resume-photo/
- Professional headshot: https://jobface.wezzik.com/professional-headshot/
- Free resume builder: https://jobface.wezzik.com/resume-builder/
- Resume templates: https://jobface.wezzik.com/resume-templates/
- Career guides: https://jobface.wezzik.com/blog/

## Editorial topics

- Choosing a clear and job-appropriate resume photo
- Professional headshot versus resume photo
- One-page resume layout
- Writing a concise resume summary
- Using ATS resume keywords truthfully

## Product facts

- Basic tools can be tried without signing up.
- The site offers downloadable basic results for resume photos and resumes.
- Users should keep important information as normal text so recruiters and assistive technologies can read it.
